witness.source:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent contract witnesses for the assigned BASE mutation probe only."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
script = Path(sys.argv[1])
mutant = sys.argv[2]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("pins_under_probe", script)
pins = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(pins)


def iso_ns(value):
    secs, sub = divmod(value, 1_000_000_000)
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(secs, tz=timezone.utc).strftime(
        "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S") + ".%09d+00:00" % sub


with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="contract-witness-", dir=script.parent) as tmp:
    tmp = Path(tmp)
    binary = tmp / "mini.bin"
    data = b"kotoba-mutation-witness-v1\n" + bytes(range(64))
    ns = 1_700_000_000_123_456_789
    if mutant == "M09":
        data = b"A" * (1 << 20) + b"tail not included\n"
    binary.write_bytes(data)
    os.utime(binary, ns=(ns, ns))
    sha = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    ma = {"omp_binary_sha256": sha, "omp_binary_mtime": iso_ns(ns),
          "opencode_binary_sha256": sha}
    opencode = binary
    facts = {"full_sha256": sha, "binary_size": len(data)}
    if mutant == "M01":
        ma["omp_binary_mtime"] = "2000-01-01T00:00:00.000000000+00:00"
        expected_exit, focus = 1, "omp_binary_mtime"
    elif mutant == "M02":
        opencode = tmp / "absent.bin"
        expected_exit, focus = 2, "opencode_binary_sha256"
    elif mutant == "M03":
        ma["OMP_binary_sha256"] = ma.pop("omp_binary_sha256")
        expected_exit, focus = 2, "OMP_binary_sha256"
    elif mutant == "M04":
        ma["cursor_binary_sha256"] = sha
        expected_exit, focus = 2, "cursor_binary_sha256"
    elif mutant == "M05":
        ma["omp_binary_sha256"] = sha[:8] + ("0" if sha[8] != "0" else "1") + sha[9:]
        expected_exit, focus = 1, "omp_binary_sha256"
    elif mutant == "M06":
        ma["omp_binary_sha256"] = sha + ":ignored"
        expected_exit, focus = 3, "omp_binary_sha256"
    elif mutant == "M07":
        ma["omp_binary_mtime"] = iso_ns(ns + 1)
        expected_exit, focus = 1, "omp_binary_mtime"
    elif mutant == "M08":
        ma["opencode_binary_mtime"] = "2000-01-01T00:00:00.000000000+00:00"
        expected_exit, focus = 1, "opencode_binary_mtime"
    elif mutant == "M09":
        prefix_sha = hashlib.sha256(data[:1 << 20]).hexdigest()
        ma["omp_binary_sha256"] = ma["opencode_binary_sha256"] = prefix_sha
        facts["prefix_sha256"] = prefix_sha
        expected_exit, focus = 1, "omp_binary_sha256"
    elif mutant == "M10":
        ma["omp_binary_mtime"] = iso_ns(ns).replace("+00:00", "0+00:00")
        expected_exit, focus = 3, "omp_binary_mtime"
    else:
        raise ValueError(mutant)
    baseline = tmp / "baseline.json"
    baseline.write_text(json.dumps({"measured_against": ma}))
    argv = ["--baseline", str(baseline), "--omp-binary", str(binary),
            "--opencode-binary", str(opencode), "--json"]
    code, out, err = pins.run_capture(argv)
    payload = json.loads(out)
    focused = next((row for row in payload["checks"] if row["pin"] == focus), None)
    print(json.dumps({"mutant": mutant, "argv": argv, "input_pins": ma,
                      "facts": facts, "expected_contract_exit": expected_exit,
                      "actual_gate_exit": code, "focus_pin": focus,
                      "focus_verdict": focused["verdict"] if focused else "ABSENT_FROM_REPORT",
                      "gate_stdout": out, "gate_stderr": err}, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    sys.exit(0 if code == expected_exit and payload["exit_code"] == expected_exit else 1)
